title: From collection downloads to inspectable agent inputs

liveRefresh.scope: Five public index/manifest files only; this refresh does not repeat the earlier complete file audit or tool smoke test.

implementationSessionReport.limits: Historical aggregate report from the implementation session. Raw logs and private repository records are excluded; these checks are not independently reproduced by this ARWP documentation change.

lessons.title: Keep definitions in one place
lessons.finding: A project definition feeds visible English copy, JSON and JSON-LD. Stable term URLs resolve to actual page anchors. Project format names use additionalType; about describes the real subject.

transfer.whenApplicable: A site explains recurring project terms across pages and downloads.
transfer.verification: Compare the displayed definition with the JSON value and resolve every term URL.
transfer.limit: A project vocabulary is not automatically a universal taxonomy or a canonical knowledge unit.

lessons.title: Publish from an approved projection
lessons.finding: Website catalogs and agent downloads consume explicit released records after current availability filtering. Website metadata stays separate from the canonical knowledge corpus.

transfer.whenApplicable: A repository contains authoring drafts, approved editions and withdrawn records.
transfer.verification: Reject a missing approval binding; verify that held records never enter public membership or dependencies.
transfer.limit: A valid schema, main branch or successful build does not grant publication authority.

lessons.title: Say what each relationship means
lessons.finding: The relationship dictionary defines direction, endpoint kinds and authority. Navigation, evidence and task orchestration edges remain distinguishable. A reference to a source is not a support verdict.

transfer.whenApplicable: Software traverses a graph that mixes knowledge and product navigation.
transfer.verification: Resolve both endpoints and reject reversed source-to-claim edges or invented evidence roles.
transfer.limit: Do not infer a reverse edge or promote website navigation to scientific evidence.

lessons.title: Count shared IDs before naming similarity
lessons.finding: Collection overlap uses shared stable idea IDs and retains zero-overlap pairs. Catalog topic membership comes from explicit selectors rather than inferred meanings.

transfer.whenApplicable: A consumer needs to compare released collection membership.
transfer.verification: Recompute intersections from the same approved snapshot, including empty intersections.
transfer.limit: This measures shared membership, not semantic similarity, usefulness or quality.

lessons.title: Give each public payload a contract
lessons.finding: The public schema index exposes 20 JSON Schema contracts, including individual cards, collections, agent packs, manifests, profiles and run traces. Compatible optional fields keep existing consumers working.

transfer.whenApplicable: Several clients consume independently downloadable JSON files.
transfer.verification: Validate real generated payloads as well as negative cases against the advertised schema; version breaking changes.
transfer.limit: Shape validation does not prove accuracy, language quality or fitness for a task.

lessons.title: Hash the file the client receives
lessons.finding: Download digests and byte counts are computed from the final serialized UTF-8 bytes, including the final newline. Parsed and reserialized JSON may have different bytes. Corpus snapshot identity and file identity are separate.

transfer.whenApplicable: Clients cache, verify or compare mutable website downloads.
transfer.verification: Hash response bytes after HTTP content decoding; compare both SHA-256 and byte length.
transfer.limit: A checksum detects byte mismatch. It is not a signature, source review or proof of truth.

lessons.title: Make checksum exclusions explicit
lessons.finding: The checksum manifest covers public JSON payloads but excludes itself. A self-hash would make the file depend on its own unfinished bytes. Catalog download metadata follows the same boundary.

transfer.whenApplicable: A generated manifest describes the files produced in the same build.
transfer.verification: Check that all intended JSON files are listed once and the manifest explicitly declares its own exclusion.
transfer.limit: The excluded file still needs an external trust or observation boundary when authenticity matters.

lessons.title: Retain change history without reviving old content
lessons.finding: Explicit append-only checkpoints retain membership and hashed descriptors rather than archived knowledge prose. Builds read the ledger; an explicit checkpoint operation records a new edition before release.

transfer.whenApplicable: Old editions must remain identifiable while current notices still govern use.
transfer.verification: Verify old edition payloads remain unchanged and the current built state has a retained checkpoint.
transfer.limit: Removal alone does not explain retraction, uncertainty or retirement. Recording time is not deployment time.

lessons.title: Let agents fetch one collection precisely
lessons.finding: Thin indexes lead to per-collection manifests with release and snapshot bindings, exact member versions, payload URLs, digests and sizes. Availability and notice URLs remain discoverable.

transfer.whenApplicable: An agent needs one collection without downloading the entire catalog.
transfer.verification: Follow an index entry, resolve every member and compare its exact downloaded bytes with the manifest.
transfer.limit: A hash-valid old edition may still have a current safety notice; identity is not continued approval.

lessons.title: Preserve conditions and missing values
lessons.finding: Profiles preserve each member’s use conditions, limits and source pointer. Agent-authored selection guidance is marked separately. Ten released ideas lacked avoid_when; flags describe that absence rather than inventing safety advice.

transfer.whenApplicable: Collections combine ideas with different applicability and exclusions.
transfer.verification: Check provided flags and compare each condition with its released source field.
transfer.limit: One member’s condition does not describe the whole collection. Missing avoidance text does not mean unrestricted use.

lessons.title: Keep order separate from dependency
lessons.finding: Ordinary collections keep their supplied positions but declare sequence_required false. A suggested starting item is not a prerequisite. Learning paths and playbooks get different order semantics only when their released kind says so.

transfer.whenApplicable: A UI or agent receives an ordered array of knowledge items.
transfer.verification: Inspect the declared kind, position and sequence flags before asking the user to follow a fixed sequence.
transfer.limit: Do not invent a course, workflow or learning dependency from display order. All 123 observed collections were ordinary collections.

lessons.title: Resolve dependencies from explicit edges
lessons.finding: Dependencies use explicit requires edges from the member to a currently public target, with version, data URL and within-collection status. The projection neither reverses edges nor invents a topological order.

transfer.whenApplicable: A collection contains genuine prerequisites or references to other released items.
transfer.verification: Check edge direction, target availability and exact target version; exclude held targets.
transfer.limit: A related item or earlier position does not establish a prerequisite.

lessons.title: Trace where an output came from
lessons.finding: An optional output trace distinguishes sourced summaries, agent reasoning, user input and observed results. It binds exact item versions and source locations to output locations; W3C PROV describes derivation separately from evidence support.

transfer.whenApplicable: An agent combines released knowledge with its own reasoning and user material.
transfer.verification: Verify each declared source pointer against the pinned release and require an observation basis for observed results.
transfer.limit: wasDerivedFrom does not mean supports. Complete trace coverage is not independent verification or a completed task.

lessons.title: Treat pointers as addresses
lessons.finding: Trace validation checks actual JSON Pointer resolution, including escape handling, array indexes and nonempty source readings. It rejects inherited object properties and invalid addresses.

transfer.whenApplicable: A client cites exact input or output fields rather than whole documents.
transfer.verification: Test invalid escapes, leading-zero array indexes, missing fields and inherited keys, alongside valid addresses.
transfer.limit: A resolving pointer identifies a location; it does not prove the cited field justifies the output.

lessons.title: Bound supplemental references before fetching
lessons.finding: Trace processing limits supplemental entries before reading extra assets, then validates them against the current released items. This prevents a validation request from triggering unbounded additional reads.

transfer.whenApplicable: User-supplied references can cause extra server-side reads.
transfer.verification: Exercise oversized input and confirm rejection occurs before supplemental asset access.
transfer.limit: A shape-only fixture cannot establish runtime read bounds; inspect or instrument the actual access path.

lessons.title: Validate what the tool advertises
lessons.finding: Final review caught a mismatch: the tool returned PROV data but its closed output schema did not permit that property. The response schema was corrected and success and failure responses were checked against it.

transfer.whenApplicable: An MCP client relies on the advertised output schema.
transfer.verification: Validate actual returned structured content against the tool’s declared output schema, including error-shaped responses.
transfer.limit: A handler-level pass can still leave standards-following clients unable to accept the result.

lessons.title: Check source, build and live state separately
lessons.finding: The implementation report records local checks, an exact source tree, deployment verification and a complete live checksum audit separately. Hosted CI executed no steps and was not reported as passing.

transfer.whenApplicable: A local build passes but remote execution or deployment has a separate state.
transfer.verification: Compare the released revision, public bytes and protocol behavior; record unavailable CI as not executed.
transfer.limit: A commit, deployment submission or dry run alone does not establish the public state.

lessons.title: Leave search and user outcomes unknown
lessons.finding: These changes made downloads and tool responses inspectable. No controlled search, citation, traffic or task-success measurement accompanied this case. Synthetic protocol probes tested validation behavior only.

transfer.whenApplicable: Technical work is being recorded as reusable ARWP experience.
transfer.verification: Keep unmeasured outcome values null and require a separately authorized, scoped observation before claiming improvement.
transfer.limit: Do not turn this case into a ranking tactic, empirical efficacy claim or learned performance prior.

lessons.title: Teach consumers to follow the sitemap index
lessons.finding: The website now uses a root sitemap index and five leaf sitemaps. Crawl audits and submission tooling were updated to read actual leaves rather than assume the root contains page URLs.

transfer.whenApplicable: A growing catalog splits page URLs into multiple sitemaps.
transfer.verification: Read the root, follow leaf sitemap URLs and compare the union with the intended public routes.
transfer.limit: Splitting sitemaps changes a discovery interface; it does not prove crawling, indexing or ranking improvements.

lessons.title: Keep visible and machine catalog descriptions aligned
lessons.finding: Download descriptions in JSON-LD are enriched after public files are serialized, using their final bytes. Visible catalog links and hydration share the dataset definitions.

transfer.whenApplicable: A page describes downloads in visible text and machine-readable metadata.
transfer.verification: Compare the built page, hydrated view and downloaded file metadata; reject mismatched catalog links or digests.
transfer.limit: A valid static page can still disagree with the hydrated client or mutable downloads.

lessons.title: Supply the source fields a trace needs
lessons.finding: Solution Pack method downloads now include the full released reading fields, including conditions, evidence and sources, so a trace can resolve meaningful source locations.

transfer.whenApplicable: An agent must attribute output to a method and its conditions.
transfer.verification: Resolve every referenced method field against the actual downloaded pack, not a richer internal record.
transfer.limit: An item ID alone is not a usable reading pointer, and keeping a condition out of a compact download can change its meaning.

lessons.title: Locate a failed check before changing the gate
lessons.finding: An unrelated fresh-main UI change failed an existing design guard during integration. The implementation moved the misplaced storage access into the existing logic layer and retained the guard.

transfer.whenApplicable: Integration introduces a validation failure outside the new data files.
transfer.verification: Identify the failing revision and rule, repair the actual layer boundary, then rerun the unchanged check.
transfer.limit: A baseline failure does not justify weakening a check or attributing all failures to the current feature.
